messages:
Priya Singh: Partner X sent an adapter for LangChain/LlamaIndex flows. Quick smoke showed streaming handshake + telemetry gaps.
Sam - Integrations: Repro steps: curl to gateway with adapter=partnerx-alpha, flow=llamaindex, stream=true -> stream falls back and p95 spikes ~1.8s.
Leah Kim: Root cause looks like chunk-size header mismatch + missing tenant_id header. Adapter advertises 1024 but we expect 256.
Marta (Partner PM): Partner requests marketplace listing next week. Can we do a preview badge?
Tess - Marketplace: We can add "Preview: streaming best-effort" badge but need legal copy and a known-issues list.
Lina Legal: Draft legal blurb for preview listing: we need a short disclaimer + SLA note. I can provide draft by EOD Tue.
Sam - Integrations: Low-risk mitigation: gateway-side clamp to 256 tokens + telemetry shim to pull tenant_id from auth header. I can prototype today.
Leah Kim: I'll add unit test for KV-shard hydration and run H100/A10G smoke once clamp is in. Expect numbers tomorrow.
Priya Singh: If clamp + smoke pass we'll allow a Preview listing and push co-announcement. If not, postpone. Marta, hold marketing assets until perf numbers.
dev-bot: CI for branch partnerx-clamp started.
Sam - Integrations: Terraform module + onboarding doc in progress, ETA 48h.
Leah Kim: Posting preliminary H100 numbers in thread once CI passes.
Priya Singh: Action summary: Sam - clamp + terraform (48h); Leah - tests + H100/A10G smoke (24-36h); Lina - legal copy (EOD Tue); Tess/Marta - marketing hold.
Marta (Partner PM): Noted. I'll prep contingency copy if we need to delay.
Priya Singh: Thanks team 4aa
